integrity: Analytic proof with exact-rational checker of the critical coefficient sign and enclosures; the exact infinite coefficient-sign argument is given in the proof rather than inferred from finite tests.
scientific_limitations: The sharp inequality, its exact affine variational characterization, and the limiting constant were previously established. The new result is only the positive first-order dimensional deficit and eventual uniqueness; it does not supply an explicit all-dimension threshold or an independent historical-priority determination.
title: A sharp first-order dimensional gap for convex-body centroid displacement
